source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A brightly lit environment with frequent stimulation, intended to keep the client alert throughout their stay","B":"Encouraging frequent visitors and higher levels of activity to help keep the client engaged","C":"Fairly few specific environmental changes beyond what a typical postpartum room would already provide","D":"A quiet, dimly lit environment, padded side rails, and suction/oxygen readily available at the bedside"}}
source_row.rationale: Seizure precautions for a client at risk for eclampsia include a quiet, dimly lit environment (reducing stimuli that could trigger a seizure), padded side rails, and suction/oxygen readily available at the bedside.
